rongmei.title: Aniu naga mei lung pui ram

lines: 1. Aniu NAGA mei ram kum gaimei mak ge,
Nzianmei ruprian guay ta zaupuki
Khou ring nruaina kazat guay khuan gai e,
Hei kum meiram gairui meiguai lung ti thao e.
Gai chang e aniu lung pui ram hei,
Gaimei rana padik e,
Kagan kathui aniu lungpui ram ti..hei thuan ne,
Kagan ka..thui aniu chun chamv ma lung e,
Gai chang e Naga mei aniu lung pui ram hei.
2. Nthei thei nung aniu poupei kinc khou muh,
Khat khat ta sang-na rih subam khuan ne,
Ntao hei aniu alaunun kinkhou muh,
Guangc kandih kumna aniu kandih ta thuan ne.
3. Aniu pou-pei rui lung lou dumei ram hei,
Chamvdaan chui bam mo kandih pri si ye.
Ravguangc zan khou aniu ram ta thuan bamni.
Ravguangc rui aniu thou tan khang ndiw lou e.
4. Kara gaimei tingthai kum Naga mei ram,
Kaganv thui tazeidui gaimei kum e,
Aniu Nagamei guai duikum luangbam e.
Aniu Nagamei ram ta phulak nga bam e.
5. Aniu pouh-peic rui khamv lou mei ram pangc khou
Nagamei ram kummei gaimei mak ge,
Duipi duibaa thang mei guay rui zuan guang e,
Mi ram gaimei lunlungc kum mei guai neihla e.
